intent: Sanity-check test quality using independent review and failing counterexamples, repair meaningful gaps without weakening acceptance conditions, and keep publication on hold.
artifact_state: Local, uncommitted v0.4.0 draft after cumulative pass eighteen. Four productive test-audit passes are complete. Publication remains on hold; no commit, push, or publication was made.

criteria.text: Check whether tests reject plausible faults rather than trusting a green count.
criteria.evidence: Three independent reviewers and parent experiments covered helper oracles, privacy/side effects, and CI/packaging. Ten meaningful code mutants and two CI failure fixtures escaped earlier checks and are now detected. Three positive controls were already detected. Commands exercised actual temporary source, in-process mutations, and installed artifacts; no broad mutation score is claimed.

criteria.text: Repair the demonstrated production defect and keep assertions tied to public behavior.
criteria.evidence: Accepted Evidence subclass serialization could emit26000 characters under a reported four-character cap. The helper now emits canonical Evidence fields. The output/provenance regression fails against the original defect and passes after repair. Review removed an overprescriptive no-serializer-invocation assertion, retaining the output-only regression.

criteria.text: Strengthen missed behavior without changing requirements or hiding failures.
criteria.evidence: Independent-invalid-field report checks, external sanitizer/cap interaction, post-call provider invocation assertions, valid HTTP byte-boundary fixtures, redirect/timeout wiring with nondefault timeout, standard content-open privacy observations, and directory-aware installer snapshots all detect their intended faults. CI explicitly rejects empty/all-skipped results and compares source/wheel Python bytes with installed retrieval smoke.

criteria.text: Verify final code and portable packaging while preserving honesty and publication hold.
criteria.evidence: Final suite:159 tests pass. Offline source/wheel build and separate-environment installed checks pass, including real retrieve CLI and canonical serializer/provenance regression, prior verifier/memory behaviors, six host profiles, seven canonical skill files, ten installed links, dry-run/idempotence and read-only diagnostics. Exact archive bytes include helper Python, tests, guides and audit records. Skill validation and46 local doc links pass; runtime dependencies remain empty and both small-text disclaimers remain. Remote CI is unrun; publication hold preserved.

claims.text: The audit establishes bounded regression detection and one concrete repair, not comprehensive correctness.
claims.evidence: Each listed fault has an independently exercised failing witness or entrypoint. Fault selection is targeted and small; model behavior, native host discovery, real HTTP behavior, all possible I/O operations, and remote GitHub CI were not measured.

claims.text: The final local helper and portable distribution pass the strengthened deterministic checks.
claims.evidence: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v completed Ran159 tests and OK. Installed package origin is outside the checkout; retrieval, canonical bounded output/provenance, verifier and memory paths, six profiles, payload parity and diagnostic side effects pass. Exact CI negative controls were independently executed locally; GitHub-hosted jobs were not invoked.

review_coverage: Three independent read-only audits, followed by independent reruns of the same mutants and selected adjacent counterexamples. The parent separately reproduced failed-sanitizer provider invocation and checked its new assertion. No source writer reviewed solely by rerunning a green suite.

limitations: Best effort only. No promises or guarantees of zero mistakes, correctness, alignment, effectiveness, or security.

Targeted fault injection is not an exhaustive mutation score, coverage proof, or general accuracy measurement. The test count grows from156 to159; replaced assertions and fixtures matter more than that count.
HTTP tests mock the transport. No live endpoint, redirect server, external credential, or real network request was used. Existing access controls and callback trust requirements remain.

In-process mutations affect in-process tests; subprocess CLI tests import original source in those particular experiments. Separate source-copy and installed-wheel experiments provide entrypoint evidence.
Directory/byte/mode snapshots detect persistent state; standard io.open/builtins.open observations do not monitor every syscall, transient effect, or attempted external action.
Exact CI script fragments were exercised locally, including installed import origin. Remote GitHub Actions and its Python3.10/3.13 matrix were not run because publication remains on hold.
Model behavior and native skill discovery are separate from helper tests. Earlier inconclusive process observations and unrun routing scenarios remain in historical reviews.

Historical reports preserve earlier counts and limits rather than claiming coverage of the new repair.

side_effects.evidence: No new runtime dependency, automatic authority, PII collection, external service access, publication, or relaxed expected behavior. Source writer preserved prior user changes and historical review evidence; broken copies were isolated.
